(Vincent Alban/Chicago Tribune) By Doug GeorgePUBLISHED: April 13, 2026 at 5:14 PM CDT | UPDATED: April 13, 2026 at 5:19 PM CDTGetting your Trinity Audio player ready...Summer Smash has unveiled its lineup for 2026, with headliners including Lil Uzi Vert, Chief Keef, Skrillex, Bladee x Yung Lean, Playboi Carti and Lil Baby. The three-day festival of hip hop music, presented by Lyrical Lemonade and concert promoter SPKRBX, returns June 12-14 to the campus of SeatGeek Stadium (7000 S. Harlem Ave.) in Bridgeview.
